batting.name: SS Tiwary
batting.dismissal: st KC Sangakkara b PP Chawla

batting.name: R Sathish
batting.dismissal: c KC Sangakkara b IK Pathan

batting.name: Harbhajan Singh
batting.dismissal: c KC Sangakkara b L Ablish

batting.name: DPMD Jayawardene
batting.dismissal: c SS Tiwary b SL Malinga

batting.name: KC Sangakkara
batting.dismissal: c S Dhawan b SL Malinga

batting.name: Yuvraj Singh
batting.dismissal: c JP Duminy b KA Pollard

balls.text: another slower ball, and it beats Zaheer's swipe and Sanga hits direct to deny them the leg-bye
and he keeps getting slower and slower, 94.7kph, and McLaren steos out and wafts and is through with the shot when the ball arrives and hits the stumps
this yorker is accurate, on the leg-stump line, all he manages is a single
tries the regulation pace yorker, and it's a big wide down the leg side - first wide or no-ball of the innings
oh he is doing well here! Another slower ball, and Harbhajan is early into the shot on the leg side, it comes almost of the back of the bat, and lobs to Sanga
as expected another slower ball, worked away for one to deep square leg
slower ball, 98kph, beats his slog and goes for a leg-bye
yorker outside off, the thick inside edge goes as far as short fine for one
another length ball, looks to go down the ground this time but doesn't get hold of it
lovely shot, part sweep, part flick, gets across the stumps, and whips this length ball from outside off stump for a flat six over square leg - what wrists
loopy slower ball, dragged from outside off to short fine for a single
full and wide outside off, Bhajji goes for the big slog, gets the inside edge that beats both the stumps and the keeper
low full toss, driven wide of sweeper-cover, comes back for two
slower yorker outside off, bunted away to cover for one
with that little margin of error, beautifully bowled yorker, 132kph, seems it is middle-stump line, moves away a touch, beats Pollard who is making room, and uproots the off stump
short ball, not much pace on it, and Pollard makes room and murders it past midwicket. Blink, and it was there past the rope
slower ball, dragged across to midwicket for a single
yorker length, gets a thick edge to short third
length ball, driven down to long-off for one
dropped at wide long-off by Ablish, it was a low full toss absolutely hammered flat and low and it virtually just broke through Ablish's body
gives him a length ball outside off, JP gets an inside edge as he looks for the big shot over extra
another near yorker, just outside off, hit to mid-on for one
full and wide again, only a single to extra cover
slower ball, 114ks, Pollard is early into it, gets a leg-bye, though
full and wide, driven to deep point for one
fullish on the pads, flicked away for a single
nice shot, a typical JP touch, low full toss on the pads, and he plays it late and places it wide of short fine leg
short and flat, hit to deep midwicket for one
fuller, turned away to wide of mid-on for two
beats him with the arm ball, appeals for lbw, but it going down the leg side
full on the pads, and helped away for one
short and flat, pushed to wide of long-on, and comes back for two
punched away from off-stump line for a single
first bit of intent from JP, gives him the charge, gets close to ball and lofts him over wide long-on, clean strike
beauty! tossed up outside off, and then it breaks in sharply to beat a forward defensive from KP, but it is turning too much to get an lbw - first extra of the innings, is this leg-bye
flat again, into the pads, worked away for two, fine of deep square leg
flat and straight, KP stays back and defends
quick delivery, back of a length, pushed to short midwicket
gets a bouncer first up, which he manages to keep down and gets off the mark
well bowled, well kept, slower offcutter, gets an edge from Sathish that is dying on the keepr but Sanga perhaps knew that a slower one was coming and stood closer than usual and takes this easily
this time it's Duminy's turn to dive full length as he is sent back by Sathish as he has hit it straight to Mahela and cover! Duminy, though, puts in the dive to beat the fielder by half a frame
lovely running! pushes a back-of-a-length delivery to the right of Irfan and puts in the big dive to beat the bowler's direct hit, and then gets up fast to claim the second off the ricochet
slower offcutter, enough width on it to be cut away, and wide enough of deep point to come back for two
another full toss, pushed down to long-on for another single
on the pads, worked to deep midwicket for one
missed out, full toss outside leg with the fine leg inside the circle, but Mahela is very fine and dives to save three runs on this tap behind the wicket
plays a similar delivery straighter this time, down to long-on for one
flighted delviery again, Duminy has to wait and wait before he can play the shot, which goes straight to midwicket
full and wide, driven against the turn to sweeper-cover
overpitched on off, drives to wide of cover for one
lovely shot, shapes to charge at him, and sees the bowler dragging the length back and rocks back in the crease to cut it between backward point and short third
stays flat still and beats him on the late-cut
flat delivery, hit straight to mid-off
doesn't pick the straighter one, turns his wrists too early but because he has played with soft hands the leading edge goes along the ground
short ball, guided to short third man for a single
pushed to wide of mid-on for the sixth single from the over
dances down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball, and pushes it down to long-on
sits back and waits for this flighted ball to turn and then works it to fine leg
full on the pad, and worked around the corner
again tossed up like a millionaire, low full toss, and hit to the left of Powar, and he dives but can't take the low catch. Very tough chance
tossed up again, hit back down the ground, and Powar dives to get a hand to it
overpitched this time, and hit to wide of long-on, which allows him to come back for the second
runs a quicker ball past the slip and charges back for the second
Chawla takes out SRT again, and raises his arm in quiet triumph! Tendulkar looks for the big sweep again, but this is the straighter one and he ends up swinging outside the line of it, and is bowled
Lee misfields at deep midwicket and lets through a slog-sweep for four - it should have been two
flighted around middle, looks to go inside-out, gets the inside half back to the bowler
comes forward this time, and pushes it to cover
tossed up generously, Duminy comes forward and waits till it pitches before playing the forward-defensive. is he reading him off the pitch?
full on the pads, turned around the corner for one
lovely shot, full offbreak, but SRT waits back, gets low, and guides it past the keeper. Delicate
late-cuts this one against the turn but straight to point
pushes a regulation offbreak down to long-off
another googly outside off, driven square, wide of point, gets a single
moves across the stumps and flicks this to short midwicket
another googly, Chawla does that to foreign batsmen often, and he beats Duminy who is on the back foot, and hence in the crease

quick quick stumping, a googly pushed through him, and it beats Tiwary. His foot drags onto the line and Sanga is alert to it, and is super quick in whipping the bails off - which is why Sanga, and not Bisla, should keep wicket for Punjab
full on the pads, gets a single to deep square leg
flighted on the pads, turned to fine leg for one
full, nearly a yorker, worked away for one to midwicket
bunted into the leg side for a single
on the pads, and helped around the corner
flat, off-stump line, punched away to sweeper-cover
flighted on the pads, pushed down to long-on
back of a length and pulled away to deep midwicket
quicker one, and he has really fired this toppie in, 96.4kph, and speeding up all the time, and an unsuspecting Rayudu has been done in and bowled through the gate as he looks to flick it to on
looks to work this to on again, but gets a leading edge, a safe, soft one
flighted on the pads, no turn, and he delicately helps it away late enough to beat short fine leg
overpitched, and pushed down to long-on
flicked away from leg-stump line to deep midwicket
whipped away from in front of stumps
short and wide again, this time, though, he has got a deep point in place - so finally he bowled to his field
short and wide again, and Rayudu cuts this in front of square, between cover and cover-point, top shot
poor bowling again, short, into the pads, fine leg is up, and Rayudu cashes in
length ball outside off, pushed straight to mid-off
looks to punch down the ground, mis-hits towards wide of mid-on
poor start, short and wide, and cut away for four

he is batting like Bravo today! even with the keeper up to the stumps he gives Pathan the charge and goes inside-out and chips him over extra cover, with that back leg leaving ground as he completes the shot
flicked from outside off to wide of mid-on for a single
pushed away wide of mid-on this time, for a single
that's a Bravo flick - well almost. Takes a big step down and extravagantly flicks it from outside off to over midwicket. The back leg slightly in the air
lovely shot, dances down the track as if to a spinner, and lofts him over mid-off
angling across him, punched square of the wicket
ordinary bouncer, no real effort in it, 128kph - and it's not the attempted slower one either - and Rayudu has enough time to rock back and pull it fine of fine leg
moves across the stumps and turns this one to on, but finds square leg
back of a length, just outside off, defended back to the bowler
middle-stump half-volley, moves across, and flicks it to square leg for four
slower ball this time, almost a yorker, flicked to midwicket
moves across the stumps, but Lee is fast and just outside off, and there is no big shot forthcoming
more powerful drive, and straight towards Goel this time
slower ball, and nicely driven with an open face but Goel makes a full-length dive at short cover to deny them even a single
looks to play the square cut but the ball doesn't quite come on, and he ends up hitting straight to cover-point
slight swing again, pushed to mid-off, and he has hit it too hard to come for a single
there is slight swing this time, but Rayudu drops it towards mid-off and runs, and makes it before a loopy throw from Love Ablish arrives
he strikes first ball. Played on by Dhawan who looks to glide it to third man. Perhaps he played it for the swing but it went straight and cramped him up. Too close to his body for that shot
lovely straight on-the-up punch and despite Lee's getting a hand to it, it has enough in it to get them two
142.5kph, into the body, SRT gets an inside edge onto the pad and then towards fine leg
not the most convincing of shots, but manages to clear backward point with this mis-timed slash outside off
slower ball, full and straight, defended towards midwicket
looks to leave one alone outside off, but ends up playing at it and dabbing to third man
slight shape in towards Dhawan, 142kph, the batsman gets a single off the inside edge onto the pad
and Pathan finishes it with a bullet over mid-on, and finally Punjab win in Mohali
length ball, hit to wide of long-on, and he comes back for two to level the scores
another quick yorker, this time it lands correctly, and is a dot ball

and Sodhi does it for Punjab, this yorker is a lowish full toss, he still has to save his toe here, and he save he does with superb timing, and the ball races along the turf past deep midwicket for four
and digs out this yorker for a single, saves his toe to be precise
there is another twist coming! Sanga is gone! Quicker delivery, 143kph, and Sanga holes out to long-off. Your turn to bat, Mr Sodhi. "Finish it off," Sanga tells Pathan as he walks off
shorter, pulled away to square leg for one
IKP has other ideas! slower length, ball, he gets under it, and strikes it clean, and strikes it big, over wide long-on
full toss, hit back at Zaheer, who misfields while going with just the right hand, and lets through a single
full delivery, driven straight to sweeper-cover for one
full toss, driven inside-out again, this time Sathish is alert, keeps them to two
fifty for Sanga! and this is the fortunate boundary after that first ball, driven inside out, Sathish comes around from sweeper-cover but it slips through his legs
lovely delivery, chalk flies as he tries to dig this yorker out and fails
that's four runs gone! absolutely smashed into the stumps at the non-striker's end, and it comes back to Zaheer as opposed to deflecting anywhere else
makes room and crashes this length ball through covers, but gets just one to sweeper-cover
Sathish saves two at wide long-on, full length dive, and then quick recovery to get the throw back in
Sanga strikes back with a vital boundary, and beautifully struck too, picks up the slower ball, drives inside-out, past extra cover

Pollard strikes with the ball after failing with the bat! Slightly slower short ball, and Yuvraj gets too much under the pull shot, holing out to deep midwicket where Duminy holds onto a smart overhead catch
full and wide, too wide
short delivery, makes room, cuts it to sweeper-cover
slower offcutter, Sanga chips down the track and is beaten
another slower ball, hit to point straight
slower ball again, the edge goes one bounce to Rayudu who does well to get his body behind this one
another run-out missed, Yuvraj late-cuts this slower ball to third man and comes back for two, but Rayudu doesn't collect the throw cleanly
slower ball, the check shot gets him a single to wide of extra cover
tries the quicker one, and gives him a half-volley, which Sanga drives majestically past extra cover
slower ball, Sanga checks his shot, hits to midwicket
looks for a single to short fine, but hasn't hit it too far from Rayudu
gets an inside edge onto the pad as he sweeps
chopped to short third for a single
steps out and chips this square on the on side
half shout for lbw but it is clearly pitched outside leg
comes down the track, gets too close to the pitch of the ball, hence no elevation
pushed down to long-off for a single
full, nearly a yorker, gets the inside edge to short fine
hurries him with this one, but he pushes it down to long-on for one
quicker delivery, stays low, but he punches it wide of long-on and comes back for two
lovely shot, 89kph, pitching middle and off and turning, waits for it, opens the face at the last moment and gets it past short third
short ball, pulled away to deep midwicket for one
full ball, driven down to long-off for one
swept away to long leg
opens the face on it, but short third man swoops quickly on the ball
defends a flattish offbreak
pushed down to long-off for a single
shot! this should ease the pressure a touch, dances down the track and lofts him over his head, and it lands on the rope
into the pads, helped away for one
worked away off the pads for a single
looks to cut but gets a bottom edge
fired down the leg side, wide
flatter delivery, defended back to the bowler
shorter, slower, pulled away to long leg for one
flat around off, hit to extra cover
flighted again, yorks him, lots of chalk flies from the crease as he digs this one out. Top over from JP
into the pads, hit back to the bowler
flighted around middle and off, defended
full ball, driven to long-off for another single
full ball, and driven down to long-off for one

Duminy into the attack, and the goat mouth has been put on Barath! Duminy bowls from round the stumps, and Barath sweeps and misses. Not sure if straightened enough, but he has been given. Clipping off, says the simulation device
short, gets a thick edge on the cut, and a single
slower ball, bunted into the vacant on side with soft hands, and comes back for two
comes down the track and chips it to long-on on the bounce
pushes a length ball down to long-on for a single
full, around off, hit back to the bowler
slower ball on the pads, worked around the corner for one
superb pull shot, Barath is good on the short stuff, the bouncer is aimed at his ribs but he pulls, and keeps it down, and finds the gap past square leg
length ball, into the pads, pushed down to long-on for one
another high-elbow shot, but straight back to Zak
good shot, gooooood shot, shimmies down the pitch, plays an on-the-up check-punch, and it goes very straight and fast for four
fuller, on off, hit back to the bowler
and flicked away off the stumps, flat and fast, and Bhajji misfields at fine leg to give away two extra runs
slower ball, Barath stretches forward and is beaten, the lbw shout is turned down because it hit outside the line of off
slower ball, checks his shot, one bounce to long-on
drops and runs this time, just to the right of Sathish but the calling is early and running quick
big wide down the leg side
short and wide, and powerfully cut away, over point, and square of third man
on the pads, flicked away, Barath wants two but is sent back, but McLaren throw is too high, and a run-out opportunity has been missed
starts with a slower ball, driven straight to extra cover
short, cut away, but straight to Pollard at point
tailing in late, defended off the back foot
pushed to sweeper-cover for another single
chops this to backward point, where Pollard's fumble lets them come through for one
full ball, driven down to long-on for one
back of a length, dabs it down to third man for one
shimmies down the track and bunts this one into the on side for one
slower again, and this time he plays it straight to midwicket
Delicate! Delicious! flighted fullish delivery, Barath makes a forward movement, then rocks back and steers it from almost keeper's gloves, fine of third man
short ball this time, pushed down to wide of mid-on for one
this is flighted, and Sanga gives him the charge and gets to the pitch of the ball, and hits it to long-on boundary all along the ground
full and flat, and hit back to Bhaj
quicker yorker this time, Barath is looking for the big slog, but gets an inside edge placed perfectly past the keeper for four
slower offcutter again, played with an open face to point
slower ball outside off, gets a thick edge for a single to third man

drama! slower ball again, Mahela hits straight to Tiwary at mid-on, who hold onto the catch safely, tumbles over, and when he is about to throw the ball up, it slips out of his hand. Mahela is walking, but Barath asks him to hold on. The umpires reckon he had it in control for enough time for it to classify as a catch. Got to agree perhaps, wasn't like the famous Gibbs non-catch, he held it for longer before he let it slip
slower ball again, this time he has to check his shot, back to the bowler
slower ball, hit powerfully but straight to mid-off
full, on middle, pushed down to long-on for another single
steers this to short third man for a single
Barath continues trying the big shot, and this time he connects well, lofting him over long-on
pushed down to long-on for one
swept away from in front of stumps, but there is deep square leg in place
Barath gives him charge first up, mis-hits it one bounce to mid-on
quicker ball, and dismissed out of his presence again, tries the bouncer into the body, but he rocks back and pulls him to deep square leg boundary, managing to roll his wrists over it
another slower ball, Mahela comes forward and presents a perfect defensive shot
slower ball outside off, and he lets it go through to Rayudu
short and wide again, stops a touch at him, and he ends up cutting it to cover
142kph, short, widish, and he punch-cuts it between cover-point and backward point, lovely lovely shot
starts off with a fast ball outside off, and Mahela throws everything at it, and the thick edge flies to third man for four
on the pads, and worked away fine for a single
and follows it up with a lovely inside-out shot past extra cover, he is punishing length balls here
lovely shot, back of a length and punched uppishly straight down the wicket, good touch again
beaten outside off, goes chasing and misses
swing into the batsman, Barath looks to steal a leg-bye and gets in the way of Dhawan and the throw
looks for the big hoick outside off but plays inside the line
short and wide, and cut away for four, he looks in good touch
nice shot, goes over extra to a back-of-a-length delivery, not easy to get under it but he manages to do it
full ball, around off, driven back to the bowler
steered down to third man for one
back of a length, around off, pushed to cover
and gone first ball? Extra bounce, and I heard something as it passed the bat, but no appeal from Mumbai, just a polite enquiry and a no
